titles.title: Dark Iris No. 2

description: Layers of pinkish white petals open to reveal the dark burgundy center of this semiabstract flower. The center of the flower resembles an upside-down heart and is situated on the bottom right corner of the work. Rippling lines of gray and black run along the righthand side of the composition.
title: Dark Iris No. 2
